content.title: University of Pennsylvania Tour [4K] + Admissions Tips #penn #collegetour #collegeadmissions
content.text: This afternoon, we explore the historic University of Pennsylvania campus in Philadelphia! After our walk around campus, join us for a breakdown of key facts and tips on admission to this highly competitive institution, including the essay portion. Writing effective essays is, after all, the best way to stand out and help you get into Penn! Founded by Benjamin Franklin in 1740, the University of Pennsylvania has established itself as one of the most prestigious universities in the world due to its renowned academics and research, Ivy League athletic programs, and countless extracurricular opportunities. The university boasts numerous undergraduate and graduate schools including the Perelman School of Medicine – the oldest in the country – the Wharton School, the Law School, the School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, and others. The D1 Quakers also boast a storied athletic history, including in NCAA basketball. The opinions provided in this video are based off of results I have had while working with students in the past, but this is no indicator of future success in your individual case. As a result, I encourage you to supplement your school research by referencing the university website before making any decisions related to your college application. https://www.upenn.edu/admissions The presence of any university logos in this video is protected by Section 107 of the Copyright Act 1976.
